description.value: Village Books & Coffee House is an independent bookstore and coffee shop tucked into a Richmond retail unit, offering a curated selection of fiction, young adult, and new-release titles alongside café service. It is a community-oriented stop where browsing a book shelf and a coffee order go hand in hand. Touring cyclists passing through Richmond's southwest corner would find it a welcoming place to rest and recharge mentally, if not mechanically.

bike_parking_detail: 6 racks within 100m: rack (6 spaces) at 31m; rack at 35m; rack at 55m; rack at 68m; stands (5 spaces) at 90m; rack at 96m. Total: 11 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website was successfully fetched and confirms an active bookstore-café at #130 - 12031 First Ave., Richmond, BC V7E 3M1, with phone 604-272-6601 matching OSM. The website focuses on book inventory and contact details with no mention of cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water, Wi-Fi, etc.), so all such fields are null. The business is clearly real, open, and publicly accessible.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible bookstore-café with confirmed website, address, and phone. A useful stop for touring cyclists in Richmond.
